title: MOSHO: A Native Discrete Shark-Inspired Metaheuristic for Hardware-Aware Neural Architecture Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.33358v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hardware-aware neural architecture search (NAS) requires jointly optimizing predictive accuracy and device-specific latency over discrete search spaces. While multi-objective swarm optimizers show promise, continuous formulations such as the Multi-Objective White Shark Optimizer (MOWSO) can suffer from quantization noise when rounded to integer-encoded architecture vectors. To address this limitation, we propose MOSHO (Multi-Objective Shark Hunting Optimization), a native discrete metaheuristic that replaces continuous motion equations with discrete architecture-editing operators. MOSHO integrates adaptive operator scheduling, energy-regulated restarts, and deferred crowding-distance truncation to enhance exploration and search efficiency. translated_title: MOSHO：一种面向硬件感知神经架构搜索的原生离散鲨鱼启发式元启发式算法
translated_abstract: 硬件感知神经架构搜索（NAS）需要在离散搜索空间上联合优化预测精度和设备特定延迟。虽然多目标群体优化器展现出潜力，但诸如多目标白鲨优化器（MOWSO）这类连续形式化方法在将解四舍五入为整数编码架构向量时可能会受到量化噪声的影响。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了MOSHO（多目标鲨鱼狩猎优化），这是一种原生离散元启发式算法，用离散的架构编辑算子取代了连续运动方程。MOSHO集成了自适应算子调度、能量调节重启和延迟拥挤距离截断机制，以增强探索能力和搜索效率。在合并的NAS-Bench-201/HW-NAS-Bench基准测试的18种场景中，MOSHO实现了0.9987的中位归一化超体积和0.0064的IGD+，产生了与NSGA-II具有竞争力的帕累托前沿，同时……
tldr: MOSHO是一种原生离散的多目标鲨鱼狩猎优化元启发式算法，通过用离散架构编辑算子替代连续运动方程，避免了连续优化方法的量化噪声问题，在硬件感知神经架构搜索中实现了与NSGA-II相当甚至更优的帕累托前沿性能。
en_tdlr: MOSHO is a native discrete multi-objective shark hunting optimization metaheuristic that replaces continuous motion equations with discrete architecture-editing operators, avoiding quantization noise and achieving Pareto fronts competitive with NSGA-II in hardware-aware neural architecture search.
